description: github.com: volcanic hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by github.com. Coverage: the area served by github.com. The listing groups 8 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about volcanic hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: MaGIC Foglio 29 Vulcano Palinuro - Isobate 10m (RNDT Dataset) - Versio; MaGIC Foglio 29 Vulcano Palinuro - Isobate 50m (RNDT Dataset) - Versio; MaGIC Foglio 29 Vulcano Palinuro - Livello 1 (RNDT Dataset) - Versione; MaGIC Foglio 29 Vulcano Palinuro - Livello 2,3,4 (RNDT Dataset) - Vers. Formats seen: TIFF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
